title: Ed, Edd n Eddy
description: Three adolescent boys, Ed, Edd “Double D”, and Eddy, collectively known as “the Eds”, constantly invent schemes to make money from their peers to purchase their favorite confectionery, jawbreakers. Their plans usually fail though, leaving them in various predicaments.

episodes.title: S1-E6A Pinch to Grow an Ed

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Edd is miffed because someone has been in his room, "touching things". So Eddy devises a plan to catch the mysterious "toucher" and make them all rich.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: The Kanker Sisters find the Eds bug collecting and take them back to their mobile home. At first the Eds like it, but after a while things start to get rough.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: The Eds find out that Nazz is having a sprinkler party. They try to show off in front of the kids and end up ripping off their skin-tight bathing suits.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Eddy decides that he and Edd are going to teach Ed some social graces and turn him into a "swingin' dude".

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Ed has to babysit his demanding and whiney sister Sarah. Edd and Eddy show up and reluctantly join "her majesty's" tea party.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Eddy is unhappy because he thinks he's short. Edd makes him a pair of hydraulic, platform shoes.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: On their way to see a new sci-fi movie, the Eds' imaginations run amok. They crash land in the junkyard and think they're on another planet.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The Eds attempt to construct a club house in a neighborhood tree to solicit memberships from their friends, but not before the Kanker Sisters take it over.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Edd takes on a paper route to save up for an electron microscope. Eddy is immediately lured by the prospect of big money.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The Eds come across an old camera. They then decide to take pictures of all the cul-de-sac kids, put them in a calendar, and sell it back to them.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: When Sarah falls in love with Edd, the rest of the gang tries to sabotage their relationship.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: The cul-de-sac kids are playing hide and go seek, and the Eds participate in the game.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Edd receives a hypnotizing pinwheel in the mail. Eddy then hypnotizes the kids.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: The Eds find a box of turkey basters. Eddy sells them to the kids as Imported Canadian Squirt Guns. The cul-de-sac turns into the Wild West.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: When the Eds find out Jonny 2x4 and Plank had a falling out, they form a matchmaking service.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Sarah locks the Eds out of the house as a movie marathon starts. They try to get into the other kids' houses to watch it.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Edd tells Eddy and Ed that to understand something, you have to take it apart so they take apart everything

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Eddy plays a joke on Ed's imagination and convinces him that Edd is a creature from another world.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Annoyed by Kevin's claims to setting world records, Eddy thinks he and his pals can do better and attempt to beat him at his own game.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: After watching Ed perform a song-and-dance routine, Eddy decides to put on a show. The Eds announce a telethon to raise money for Ed's eyebrow operation.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Ed has a loose tooth. Edd and Eddy make attempts to pull it out but can't.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Eddy is convinced Kevin must be a spy so the Eds set up an agency to track Kevin's movements.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Lost in one of his moments, Ed introduces Eddy and Edd to his imaginary friend Jib.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Eddy finds the Kanker sisters' trailer parked on his lawn for their vacation. The girls invade Ed, Edd and Eddy's lives, and Eddy resolves to find the Kankers a new spot.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 2 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Worn out by Sarah's demands, Ed to packs his room and moves.

episodes_data.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy Season 2 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Eddy's parents are out for dinner and hired Nazz to baby-sit.
